meta.name: Asur
meta.description: Set in the backdrop of the mystical city of Varanasi, Asur follows Nikhil Nair, a forensic-expert-turned-teacher, who returns to his roots at the Central Bureau of Investigation, and along with his former mentor Dhananjay Rajpoot, finds himself caught in a cat-and-mouse game with a brutal serial killer. What follows is a blend of suspense, mythology and the murders of some people totally unrelated.

videos.title: The dead can talk
videos.overview: The sudden death of a priest right in front of his teenage son sends people in a frenzy. 11 years later, Nikhil Nair, a forensic expert teaching at the FBI HQ, receives coordinates of an unknown location from a mysterious source only to find out a completely mutilated, tortured and charred body back in India. With a killer responsible for a murder that can make even the toughest cops shudder on the loose, Dr. Dhananjay Rajpoot, a forensic expert is set on a wild goose chase.

videos.title: Rabbit hole
videos.overview: The investigation takes a wild turn as Dhananjay finds out the mutilated and charred body found earlier was in fact of his wife - Sandhya. But even before he could come to terms with the inconceivable loss, Dhananjay is arrested for murdering his wife. With the clock ticking, and the pressure mounting, another body with the same mask is recovered from Nagaland.

videos.title: Peek - a - boo
videos.overview: With Dhananjay behind bars, Nikhil thinks it's all over until he gets 3 new coordinates from the same mysterious source. The killer follows the same pattern - thoroughly planned assaults targeted at random people at random locations. The chilling new development now raising more questions - Why Nikhil? And Why Now?

videos.title: Ashes from the past
videos.overview: The killer has always been a step ahead of Nikhil and Dhananjay. It's more evident than ever as Nikhil is now trapped in killer's custody and Dhananjay is behind bars. But what does the ruthless killer want? A perfect murder carried out by Nikhil himself! Meanwhile, Dhananjay finally figures out how it's all connected.

videos.title: The devil has a face
videos.overview: With a merciless killer on the loose and Nikhil in his custody, the desperate CBI now turns to DJ for help. Leaving nothing to chance, DJ gets on with the investigation. Meanwhile, Nikhil is given his new murder mission. On target, Aaditya Jalan, a billionaire philanthropist.

videos.title: The firewall
videos.overview: Worried for his family, Nikhil gives in to the killer's demand and plans to murder Aditya Jalan. But this time it's his mentor DJ who is pulling all stops to catch the killer before it too late. It's mentor vs protégé! Who will win the deadly game?

videos.title: Let there be darkness
videos.overview: 2 perfect murders down, Nikhil's given his next target… and it's none other than Dhananjay Rajpoot, his mentor and friend. For the sake of his family, will Nikhil murder his own mentor?

videos.title: End is the beginning
videos.overview: It all boils down to the final face-off! Nikhil, Dhananjay and the killer are now involved in the battle of wits and only one will survive this sinister game.

videos.title: The Dance of Death
videos.overview: DJ is haunted by the past & has taken refuge, hoping to outrun his demons. Nikhil is broken & blames himself for his daughter's death. The CBI team races against time as Shubh has planned a new attack. He warns, a new world order is coming.

videos.title: The Past, the Present and the Future
videos.overview: CBI team investigates how Shubh killed those 3 people. DJ will work outside the system to catch Shubh and will go into his past, to Varanasi. Nikhil is determined to uncover the clues leading to Shubh & finds another set of coordinates.

videos.title: Burning the Forest
videos.overview: An ATF veteran, Paul takes over the case from CBI. Nikhil and him, have conflicts but will work together for the common cause. Naina comes across a mysterious portal on the dark web and DJ meets someone from Shubh's past.

videos.title: Designing the future
videos.overview: Kesar is abducted by DJ. ATF has lost a key member & Nikhil accuses Rasul. DJ propels to dig into Rasul's background. Despite their ideological differences, DJ joins hands with Nikhil, but Rasul has already put his evil plan in motion.

videos.title: The countdown begins
videos.overview: The CBI team is trying to rescue Nusrat against all odds. Nikhil gets a clue, but before they can discover Shubh's plans, Rasul threatens them for Nusrat's life. They don't know yet that Rasul is leading them into a devious trap.

videos.title: The Domino Effect
videos.overview: ATF has to stop Shubh's next attack. While DJ goes behind Shubh's roots, the ATF team manages to get clues from Nusrat's kidnapper. They all eventually realize what Shubh's plan & attack is & how he carefully orchestrated it.

videos.title: Birth of the New God
videos.overview: The CBI members are at their lowest ebb and as they take in the ramifications, there is a hostage situation at a restaurant. While the team races against time to stop Shubh, in a stunning surprise DJ has one last trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: The God's Dilemma
videos.overview: In the Titanic battle between Good and Evil, will a seemingly unconquerable Shubh fulfil his destiny and cause a complete collapse of society, or will the forces of good, against all odds, manage to prevail?
